newsitem.title: Australia: RTRS-Cricket-England recover from bad start v South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-England recover from bad start v South Australia.

text.p: England A recovered from a bad start to their four-day match against South Australia on Friday when a century partnership between Mark Butcher and Craig White saw the tourists reach 166 for five at tea on the first day.

England A captain Adam Hollioake was dismissed by pace bowler Mark Harrity for nine for his side to be 45 for four in the morning session of play before opener Butcher and all-rounder White steadied the innings.
They added 109 for the fifth wicket before White was caught by Joe Scuderi from the bowling of spinner Brad Young for 61 shortly before tea.
Butcher was on 67 at tea and new batsman Mark Ealham two.
Harrity took two wickets with Jason Gillespie, Greg Blewett and Young taking one each.
